title: RepoPact assurance/control mapping record
description: Optional, adopter-authored record mapping an implemented control to an external assurance/regulatory framework requirement (WI051, Decision 0054). RepoPact records that a mapping, control, or evidence reference exists; it never derives legal compliance, certification, or independent audit conclusions from that presence. Framework and requirement identifiers are adopter-owned open strings -- RepoPact does not enumerate or interpret specific regulatory regimes. Evidence is always a reference (hash, repository-relative artifact path, evidence-run id, or external-system pointer); this schema has no field capable of carrying a raw payload inline. Absence of an assurance/ directory leaves a repository fully valid.

version.description: Assurance-mapping record schema version (Decision 0054 section 3). An unrecognized major version must be reported as unsupported, never interpreted optimistically.

id.description: Opaque adopter-chosen slug identifying this mapping record. Must match the filename stem.
Adopter-owned open identifier for the external framework/source (e.g. 'example-framework'). Never a RepoPact-defined regulatory enum.

version.description: Framework/source version or edition, when the framework is versioned.

source_authority.description: Where the requirement definition came from (e.g. 'official-publication', 'customer-contract', 'internal-assurance-profile', 'industry-standard', 'adopter-extension'). Adopter-chosen text; RepoPact never treats this as legally controlling.

source_ref.description: Adopter-owned pointer to the framework source text (URI, citation, or internal document reference). RepoPact never fetches or interprets this.

id.description: Adopter-owned open requirement/control identifier within the framework (e.g. 'CC6.1', '164.312(a)(1)', 'CUSTOM-AUTH-04'). RepoPact validates only that it is a non-empty string.

status.description: Adopter conclusion about whether the requirement applies. A non-'unassessed' status is an adopter assertion, never a RepoPact-derived legal conclusion.

determined_by.description: Reviewer/owner reference for the applicability conclusion.

control_refs.description: References to adopter-owned canonical RepoPact records (policy, invariant, contract, decision, work_item, role) that constitute the control. The mapping never duplicates control text RepoPact already owns canonically.

implementation_refs.description: Where the control is realized. Path-shaped kinds are repository-relative only; absolute host paths are rejected.

owner_ref.description: Optional reference to a RepoPact owner/role scope.

third_party_dependencies.description: Generic third-party/subprocessor dependencies (identity provider, cloud host, payment processor, external auditor, other service). Naming a dependency here never implies that dependency is itself compliant.

gaps.description: Open gaps/exceptions are structurally distinguishable from passing evidence. A record with an unresolved gap remains a valid RepoPact record; validity of the record never implies satisfaction of the external requirement.

review.description: Freshness metadata (ACM-005 foundation). This checkpoint stores the fields; it does not implement a drift/staleness engine.

attestation.description: An optional reference to an independent assessment/certification/attestation. Presence of this object means only that the adopter recorded a reference to an external attestation; RepoPact never independently verifies it and never treats it as RepoPact-issued certification.

ref.description: Meaning depends on kind: policy/decision/work_item canonical id, invariant INV-N id, contract repository-relative AGENTS.md path, role adopter-owned scope name.
Repository-relative path for source/configuration/workflow/test/runtime_surface kinds; canonical decision/work_item id otherwise. Never an absolute host path.

sensitivity.description: Adopter-declared sensitivity of the underlying evidence. RepoPact does not classify content; the adopter declares this explicitly.

evidence_run_id.description: Required when kind is 'evidence_run': a canonical evidence-run id (evidence/runs/<id>.json).

content_descriptor.description: Bounded, non-secret description of what was hashed. A digest is an integrity/reference mechanism, not anonymization.

path.description: Required when kind is 'repository_artifact': a repository-relative path to a bounded, redacted, or synthetic report already committed to the repository. Never an absolute host path, and never a path expected to hold a raw regulated/customer payload.

reference.description: URI or citation. Must never embed credentials.
